parties.petitioner: UP ROADWAYS RETIRED OFFICIALS AND OFFICERS ASSOCIATION

summary: Pension eligibility for Roadways employees; non-pensionable posts under U.P. Roadways pre-Corporation (1947-1972); absence of pensionable status confirmed post-absorption into U.P. State Roadways Transport Corporation; GOs 1960/1972 do not confer pension rights; Article 350 of U.P. Civil Service Regulations amendment (1977) does not apply due to exclusion of technical institutions via Note 3; reliance on Mirza Athar Beg set aside as appellants never held pensionable posts; delay in claims (8-32 years post-retirement) fatal; Employees Provident Fund Scheme benefits already availed negates subsequent pension claims; High Court dismissal upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Road Transport Corporation Act, 1950 s.3, s.44, s.45(2)(c)
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court judgment upholding denial of pension affirmed; appellants not entitled to pension as posts were non-pensionable per GOs and regulations.
